svg.aria-label: Five snapshots of one reverse-diffusion run: a scattered peptide far from the pocket at t = 1 settles into the pocket groove by t = 0.06, with the translation noise schedule plotted underneath. Illustration, not measured data.
svg.text: One docking run, step by step
Illustration, not measured data. The noise values and the sixteen-step schedule are the real ones.
Translation noise σ(t) = 0.1^(1−t) · 30^t, in ångströms (log scale). The sixteen steps are the open circles.
high noise: the peptide can be anywhere → low noise: the pose settles (yellow dots are the five panels above)
